title.en: Recording depreciation and disposal of assets

heading.en: Two ways to keep the books

hook.en: Should the machine account show today's book value, or what we originally paid? Accountants use both methods; the balance sheet looks different in each.
hook.kn: ಯಂತ್ರದ ಖಾತೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕೇ ಅಥವಾ ಮೂಲ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನೇ? ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಗರು ಎರಡೂ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

objectives.en: Record depreciation by charging it to the asset account.
Record it through a provision for depreciation account.
Find profit or loss on sale of an asset.

narration.en: Should the machine account show today's book value, or what we originally paid? Accountants use both methods; the balance sheet looks different in each.
narration.kn: ಯಂತ್ರದ ಖಾತೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸಬೇಕೇ ಅಥವಾ ಮೂಲ ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನೇ? ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಗರು ಎರಡೂ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: Method 1: charging depreciation to the asset account

body.en: Depreciation is credited directly to the asset account: Depreciation A/c Dr To Asset A/c. At the year end it is closed: Profit and Loss A/c Dr To Depreciation A/c. The asset appears in the balance sheet at its book value (cost less depreciation to date).

points.en: Depreciation A/c Dr To Asset A/c
P&L A/c Dr To Depreciation A/c

narration.kn: ಮೊದಲ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸವಕಳಿಯನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಸ್ತಿ ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Selling a depreciated machine

say.en: Depreciation each year: debit Depreciation, credit the asset. At year end it goes to profit and loss.

text.en: Depreciation A/c Dr  To Machinery A/c
P&L A/c Dr  To Depreciation A/c

say.en: Machinery cost 60,000. Three years at 6,000 a year is 18,000 written off.
Book value is 42,000 but it sold for 40,000: a loss of 2,000.
Profit or loss on sale is the sale price minus the book value.

title.en: Method 2: provision for depreciation account, and disposal

body.en: Depreciation is credited to a provision for depreciation (accumulated depreciation) account: Depreciation A/c Dr To Provision for Depreciation A/c. The asset stays at original cost; the provision is deducted from it in the balance sheet. On sale, the cost and accumulated depreciation are transferred to an asset disposal account; sale price minus book value gives profit or loss, transferred to profit and loss.

points.en: Depreciation A/c Dr To Provision for Depreciation A/c
Asset at original cost less accumulated depreciation
Profit/loss on sale = Sale price − Book value

narration.en: Depreciation is credited to a provision for depreciation (accumulated depreciation) account: Depreciation A/c Dr To Provision for Depreciation A/c. The asset stays at original cost; the provision is deducted from it in the balance sheet. On sale, the cost and accumulated depreciation are transferred to an asset disposal account; sale price minus book value gives profit or loss, transferred to profit and loss.
narration.kn: ಎರಡನೇ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸವಕಳಿಯನ್ನು ಸವಕಳಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮೂಲ ವೆಚ್ಚದಲ್ಲೇ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಾರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಾಟ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವೇ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟ.

title.en: Profit or loss on sale of an asset

caption.en: Book value = cost − accumulated depreciation (SLM: rate × cost × years). Profit (loss) = sale price − book value.

narration.en: Change the cost, rate, years and sale price and read the result of the sale.

tryThis.en: Default values: check the loss of ₹2,000.
What sale price gives neither profit nor loss?
Keep the sale price and use the machine one more year. What changes?

problem.en: Machinery costing ₹60,000 was bought on 1 April 2022 and depreciated at 10% p.a. on cost (SLM). It was sold on 31 March 2025 for ₹40,000 after charging depreciation for 2024–25. Find the profit or loss and pass the entries.

steps.en: Entries: Bank A/c Dr 40,000 and Profit and Loss A/c Dr 2,000 To Machinery A/c 42,000.

answer.en: Loss on sale ₹2,000, debited to profit and loss.
